headline: Google and Oracle announce planned TPU capacity on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Google Cloud and Oracle announced plans to deploy Google TPU capacity on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure starting in 2027. The Google Cloud Blog and Oracle press release describe OCI as the first hyperscaler outside Google to offer TPUs; Oracle says availability will ramp over multiple years, and its Chinese-language post describes a plan to reach gigawatt scale. This is a distinct announced supply route from Oracle’s NVIDIA accelerator expansion. The announcements establish the partnership and plans, not delivered capacity, customer adoption, OCI-specific TPU performance or economics.
